TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_creators
TABLE.COMMENT: Trainer spaces: one per trainer, with its own course category and public showcase

FIELD.NAME: motivation
FIELD.COMMENT: Application message, read by the administrator

FIELD.NAME: sap_siteid
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer's SecureAndPay IdSite: their sales are paid into their own account

FIELD.NAME: sap_key
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer's SecureAndPay signing key, encrypted with core\encryption

FIELD.NAME: affiliaterate
FIELD.COMMENT: Commission (%) paid by the trainer to affiliates on their courses; 0 = no affiliation

FIELD.NAME: fontstyle
FIELD.COMMENT: Showcase typeface: modern, elegant or classic

FIELD.NAME: customdomain
FIELD.COMMENT: Own domain that opens the showcase (lowercase, no www)

FIELD.NAME: legalname
FIELD.COMMENT: Seller name on invoices (company or person)

FIELD.NAME: vatrate
FIELD.COMMENT: VAT included in prices, in %; null or 0: not subject to VAT (franchise)

FIELD.NAME: invoicenotes
FIELD.COMMENT: Mentions printed at the bottom of invoices

FIELD.NAME: invoicemail
FIELD.COMMENT: E-mail each invoice to the buyer, PDF attached

FIELD.NAME: invoiceprefix
FIELD.COMMENT: Prefix of invoice numbers, empty for F-

FIELD.NAME: invoicedigits
FIELD.COMMENT: Digits of invoice numbers, 0 for no padding

FIELD.NAME: invoicestart
FIELD.COMMENT: First invoice number (to go on from a previous tool)

FIELD.NAME: creditprefix
FIELD.COMMENT: Prefix of credit note numbers, empty for AV-

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_affiliates
TABLE.COMMENT: Affiliates: users who earn a commission on the sales they bring

FIELD.NAME: payoutdetails
FIELD.COMMENT: How the affiliate wants to be paid (IBAN, PayPal...)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_referrals
TABLE.COMMENT: Orders placed after following an affiliate link

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_commissions
TABLE.COMMENT: Affiliate commissions, one per paid order line

FIELD.NAME: sellerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer who owes the commission (local_oriskill_creators.id), 0 = Oriskill

FIELD.NAME: base
FIELD.COMMENT: Amount paid for the line, before tax and after discounts

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_gateways
TABLE.COMMENT: Trainers' own Stripe and PayPal accounts, used for their courses

FIELD.NAME: publickey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stripe publishable key or PayPal client ID

FIELD.NAME: secretkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Stripe secret key or PayPal secret, encrypted

FIELD.NAME: webhooksecret
FIELD.COMMENT: Stripe signing secret (encrypted) or PayPal webhook ID

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_instoffers
TABLE.COMMENT: Payment in instalments offered by a trainer for a course

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_instalments
TABLE.COMMENT: Purchases of a trainer course paid in instalments, and where their payments stand

FIELD.NAME: firstamount
FIELD.COMMENT: First instalment when it differs from the others, 0 when equal

FIELD.NAME: extrapaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Missing instalments paid outside SecureAndPay's schedule (payment link, or recorded by the trainer)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active, late (refused, grace period), suspended (access suspended), stopped (schedule ended unpaid, grace period), completed

FIELD.NAME: latesince
FIELD.COMMENT: First unpaid instalment, 0 when up to date

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_invoices
TABLE.COMMENT: Invoices and credit notes issued in a trainer's name, numbered per trainer

FIELD.NAME: sequence
FIELD.COMMENT: Continuous number per trainer and type

FIELD.NAME: total
FIELD.COMMENT: Amount including VAT, positive for both types

FIELD.NAME: data
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot: seller, buyer, lines, mentions (a document never changes once issued)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_members
TABLE.COMMENT: Collaborators of a trainer, with their role in the trainer space

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Set once the invitation is accepted

FIELD.NAME: email
FIELD.COMMENT: Address the invitation was sent to

FIELD.NAME: role
FIELD.COMMENT: admin, teaching, support, accounting, partner or coach

FIELD.NAME: canexport
FIELD.COMMENT: May export lists of people (off for a partner unless an admin allows it)

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Invitation link secret, cleared once used

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_log
TABLE.COMMENT: What was done in a trainer space, and by whom

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who did it, 0 for Oriskill itself (automatic)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_orderforms
TABLE.COMMENT: Order forms of a trainer: a sales page with offers, paid through the trainer's account

FIELD.NAME: bumplabel
FIELD.COMMENT: Extra offered as a box to tick at the order step (order bump)

FIELD.NAME: upselllabel
FIELD.COMMENT: Offer shown after payment, paid with the saved card

FIELD.NAME: abandonsteps
FIELD.COMMENT: Abandon sequence, JSON list of {delay (hours), subject, body}; null when never set

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_formoffers
TABLE.COMMENT: Offers of an order form: the courses opened and how they are paid

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: What the offer includes, one point per line

FIELD.NAME: actags
FIELD.COMMENT: ActiveCampaign tags added to buyers of this offer, comma-separated

FIELD.NAME: subprice
FIELD.COMMENT: Monthly subscription price, 0 when not offered

FIELD.NAME: instalfirst
FIELD.COMMENT: First instalment when it differs from the others (a deposit), 0 for equal instalments

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_activecampaign
TABLE.COMMENT: A trainer's ActiveCampaign account: buyers are added to it once paid

FIELD.NAME: tags
FIELD.COMMENT: Tags added on every purchase, comma-separated

FIELD.NAME: coursetags
FIELD.COMMENT: Also tag with the name of each course bought

FIELD.NAME: unpaidtag
FIELD.COMMENT: Tag added when an instalment is unpaid

FIELD.NAME: lastresult
FIELD.COMMENT: Outcome of the last call, shown to the trainer

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_coupons
TABLE.COMMENT: Promo codes of a trainer, used on their order forms

FIELD.NAME: formid
FIELD.COMMENT: Only this order form, null for all

FIELD.NAME: instalments
FIELD.COMMENT: Also valid when paying in instalments

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_webhooks
TABLE.COMMENT: Addresses a trainer's events are posted to (Zapier, Make, own tools)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_webhooksent
TABLE.COMMENT: History of the events posted to the trainers' webhooks

FIELD.NAME: httpcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Answer of the last try, 0 when unreachable

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_studytime
TABLE.COMMENT: Time a learner spent in a trainer's course, per day (CPF)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_studymodes
TABLE.COMMENT: How the time spent is counted in a trainer's course

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_contacts
TABLE.COMMENT: CRM of a trainer: one contact per e-mail address (prospect, learner or customer)

FIELD.NAME: suspendedenrolments
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: enrolments suspended when the contact was disabled

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: learner, order, capture, checkout, manual or import

FIELD.NAME: consentdirect
FIELD.COMMENT: Agrees to the trainer's marketing e-mails

FIELD.NAME: ltv
FIELD.COMMENT: Lifetime value: invoiced less credit notes

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_contacttags
TABLE.COMMENT: Tags of the CRM contacts

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_imports
TABLE.COMMENT: Imports of contacts from CSV files, processed in the background

FIELD.NAME: headers
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: column names and a few example rows

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft, pending, running, done, cancelled or failed

FIELD.NAME: position
FIELD.COMMENT: Byte of the file the next batch starts at

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_segments
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved combinations of filters of a trainer's CRM

FIELD.NAME: filters
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: parameters of the contact list

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_emails
TABLE.COMMENT: E-mails sent to people by the platform (support: date, content, opening)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Recipient, 0 for a contact without an account

FIELD.NAME: creatorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer it was sent for, 0 for the platform's own

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_priorprogress
TABLE.COMMENT: Time and progress of a learner in a course on the previous platform (migration)

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_formstats
TABLE.COMMENT: Daily visits of the order forms and their order step, per offer

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_capturepages
TABLE.COMMENT: Capture pages of a trainer: free courses in exchange for an e-mail address

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_leads
TABLE.COMMENT: People who signed up on a trainer's capture page

FIELD.NAME: consent
FIELD.COMMENT: Agreed to receive the trainer's e-mails

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_unpaid
TABLE.COMMENT: Unpaid instalments of a purchase, open until settled or abandoned, kept as history

FIELD.NAME: cause
FIELD.COMMENT: failed (instalment refused) or stopped (schedule stopped before its end)

FIELD.NAME: amount
FIELD.COMMENT: Amount owed when last computed, amount paid once settled

FIELD.NAME: how
FIELD.COMMENT: How it was closed: auto (charged again), link (payment link), manual (by the trainer)

FIELD.NAME: payorderid
FIELD.COMMENT: Order of the payment link, 0 before the first click

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_abandons
TABLE.COMMENT: Prospects who placed an order on an order form without paying, and the reminders sent

FIELD.NAME: orderid
FIELD.COMMENT: Latest order placed (the paid one once recovered)

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: open, recovered (paid) or stopped (asked for no more reminders)

FIELD.NAME: step
FIELD.COMMENT: E-mails of the sequence sent or skipped

FIELD.NAME: sent
FIELD.COMMENT: E-mails actually sent (late ones are skipped)

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Order placed: the sequence counts from here

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_quotes
TABLE.COMMENT: Quotes in a trainer's name, numbered per trainer, turned into an invoice once paid

TABLE.NAME: local_oriskill_coachees
TABLE.COMMENT: Coach of each learner of a trainer

FIELD.NAME: coachid
FIELD.COMMENT: User id of the coach (a member with the coach role)
